critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 4199 lines (grew from 4024) — still above 700-line guideline; new timetable + points code should ideally live in /app/backend/routers/timetable.py and /app/backend/routers/points.py.
GET /api/points/history/{uid} has no role gate — any authenticated user can read any user's point history. Consider restricting to self or staff/guru/admin.

Jadwal.jsx openAdd uses local `classId`; when the Classes fetch is still pending, the add button fires a 'Pilih kelas dulu' toast. Minor UX: either disable the button until classId resolves, or let openAdd pick classes[0] automatically.

Leaderboard '/points/leaderboard' aggregates on $kelas from the points doc snapshot — if a student changes kelas later, their old points still count under their old class. Acceptable but worth documenting.
_timetable_conflict iterates db.timetable.find({'day': day}) without an index. Add compound index (day, class_id) / (day, teacher_id) / (day, room) when table grows.
